intent: Let the owner give an approved commit a release name.

edit.summary:
I added release naming to the `authoring` domain with three proposals. The draft check reports no issues. I changed nothing in `delivery`.

- **`objects.Commit`:** it has a new optional string property, `release_name`. Everything else on the object is as it was.
- **`actions.name_release`:** the owner can run it on a Commit with a `name` param, and it sets `release_name`. A precondition, `approved`, allows it only on an approved commit ("Only an approved commit is given a release name.").
- **`transitions.Commit.matrix.recorded.name_release`:** the Commit stage stays `recorded`.

The request didn't say whether naming should need a person, so I made it an ordinary owner action. I also didn't block renaming, so the owner can change a name after setting it. Both are easy to tighten if you want that.
